summary: AES Corp filed an 8-K reporting amendments to existing credit facilities with Citibank and Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation. The amendments extend revolving commitment termination dates: Citi agreement extended to August 23, 2028, and SMBC agreement to December 6, 2027, subject to conditions. No special-situation transaction is involved; this is a routine credit facility modification. The filing includes material definitive agreements as exhibits. The company is acting as borrower, not as acquirer, target, or issuer in a special situation.
